text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey. Cesario?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, why did you choose the Tiara 
path?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe it's because I want to pass the 
brilliance on to the future, just like our 
Tiara umamusume predecessors."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! That's just like me~! I 
want to leave a piece of myself for the 
future too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: My shine, and mine alone!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...Back then, I said "We're the same" and 
laughed, didn't I? But... the truth is, 
Craft...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(A corner of my mind is always cold and 
calculating, so I used to think, "Strictly 
speaking, maybe I'm a bit different.")

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
('I wish to become part of a great river. 
Nothing more than a single stream within 
the continuous flow of history.')

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Yes. I certainly thought that way. But—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe deep down, all along... you were 
right.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...! Starting from here—!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Craft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!! Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(I shall be their foundation. Their light. 
Their brilliance. For the sake of those 
girls' future.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Why is it like that, I wonder? Right now, 
it feels as if it's always been this way—)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(My heart is burning up so much, I can't 
help it...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Cesario snatches victory away———!!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ......! I won, I actually won...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing, aaaa-mazing! 
Cesario-san? You're so aaawesooome!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That was so cool! Man, I wanna get out 
there and race soon too~!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Why, last year she even received an 
invitation to a race overseas. That's just 
how talented she is—"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"From abroad!? You came from overseas!? 
Awesome! You're a total star!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but going overseas is super hard, 
y'know. My teacher even said it's still 
impossible for me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft—it's because you were there that 
I...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Craft
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha! We said the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Cesario! I'm so happy I got to 
run with you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I had to concede today. But I won't lose 
next time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's race together lots and lots of times 
again. Okay?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!
choice_data_list: That was a wonderful race, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It's all thanks to 
you, Trainer... and Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Because of her, I was able to take a step 
toward the future I desired.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And—that is precisely why, Trainer. I've 
found something new that I wish to attain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An irrepressible excitement could be felt 
in every word Cesario spoke.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Another thing lost by abandoning the 
challenge overseas.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's about proving that Japanese Umamusume 
can take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instantly understood what she was trying 
to say. In other words, the next target 
race is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is a G1 race where you can 
compete against Umamusume from around the 
world. If you wish to take on the 
world—there is no greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I want to take on the world, win, and 
inspire dreams.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I want to show a new path to the Umamusume 
running toward the future in this country!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just like Special Week-san, Japan's 
Supreme Commander, who fought against the 
entire world that day...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like Special Week on that day— there is no 
way she doesn't understand the sheer 
weight of those words.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We must train and prepare ourselves more 
than ever before. Trainer, are you 
prepared—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘If it is my beloved's wish, I will do 
anything.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding so hard for the 
great challenge ahead, I felt like 
breaking into song with those very 
verses...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Cesario held a press 
conference—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"To all the Umamusume making their mark in 
Japan... and across the world right now."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please, come to the Japan Cup. Compete 
alongside me and—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I need you to lose. For my sake, and for 
the future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those words created a massive shockwave.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Cesario-san is so amazing. The Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup was so breathtakingly 
intense—!

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Craft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!! Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She was trying so, so hard—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"—'I need you to face defeat. For my sake, 
and for the future'... huh."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting our dreams and hopes to the 
active members... Not just that, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, it needs more of that...! 
Properly! With a big BOOM...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup." Their fierce 
clash deeply stirred the public and the 
Commander-in-Chief of Japan alike.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Japan Cup— The climax where 
the world's strongest rivals await...!
